newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-PIENAAR MADE SARACENS PLAYER-COACH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PIENAAR MADE SARACENS PLAYER-COACH.

text.p: Springbok World Cup-winning captain Francois Pienaar has been appointed player-coach of his English club Saracens.
Pienaar, who signed a 30-month contract with the London club last December, has been handed the coaching job in the wake of the club's four league defeats in the past fortnight.
"We were in the process of looking around for a suitable candidate when Francois asked if we could consider him," said Saracens chief executive Mike Smith.
"We said yes on condition he gives up all his other commitments."
